name: "X becomes a copy of this creature" — the target copies the ability's source
notes: The copy parser only knew "the source becomes a copy of a picked object": The Flood of Mars ("put a flood counter on another target creature or land. If it's a creature, it becomes a copy of this creature") and Permeating Mass ("that creature becomes a copy of this creature") got a COPY effect pinned to their own source with a copy-source picker, the wrong direction. When the copy's object is "this creature/card/permanent" and its subject is another object, the parser now emits a targeted COPY effect on that subject (with its restriction and the line's on-resolution condition) and _addAbilityPseudo fills in the copy source from the fired ability's source permanent. The Flood of Mars is fired at a creature (becomes a copy, not an Island), at a land (becomes an Island, not a copy) and once with no target picked (nothing may fall back on the source); Permeating Mass at a creature; and a Clone copying Permeating Mass passes on what it is copying, not its own printed card.
